summary: Eleven games were played. Toronto beat Chicago 135-92, the largest margin of the night, and Portland led Phoenix by as many as 52 on the way to a 124-83 win. Anthony Edwards of Minnesota and Ty Jerome of Memphis each scored 45, and Indiana's 123-120 win over New Orleans was the closest game.

games.headline: Hawks hold off Magic 132-125 after a 44-point second
games.story: Atlanta scored 44 in the second quarter to lead 72-62 at halftime, and Orlando outscored the Hawks 38-27 in the third to get back into it. The game was tied for the last time at 6:14 of the fourth, and Atlanta went ahead for good at 118-117 with 5:00 left. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 31 for the Hawks, and Jalen Johnson had 20 points, 14 rebounds and 6 assists. Paolo Banchero led all scorers with 35 for Orlando, adding 7 rebounds and 10 assists.

games.headline: Wizards pull away from Bucks in a 38-point fourth, 128-116
games.story: Milwaukee led 56-51 at halftime, and the last tie came at 2:21 of the second quarter. Washington outscored the Bucks 38-23 in the fourth and went ahead for good at 99-98 with 9:49 to play, then built its largest lead of 13 with 7:26 left. Anthony Davis scored 34 with 12 rebounds and Trae Young had 20 points and 13 assists. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 24 points, and the Bucks made 15 three-pointers to Washington's 6.

games.headline: Edwards scores 45 as Timberwolves rout Heat 131-106
games.story: Minnesota went ahead for good at 52-50 with 4:46 left in the second quarter and led 69-59 at halftime. The Timberwolves pushed the lead to 30 with 4:29 to play. Anthony Edwards scored 45 with 10 rebounds and 9 three-pointers, and LaMelo Ball added 21 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo led Miami with 35 points and 6 rebounds.

games.headline: Hornets beat Nets 110-103 with 15 three-pointers
games.story: Charlotte led 54-48 at halftime. Brooklyn tied it for the last time at 4:13 of the third quarter, and the Hornets went ahead for good at 75-72 with 4:01 left in the period. Grayson Allen scored 21 with 5 three-pointers, and Naz Reid had 20 points and 11 rebounds. Julius Randle led Brooklyn with 33 points, 8 rebounds and 7 assists, and Michael Porter Jr. scored 26.

games.headline: Raptors never trail in a 135-92 rout of the Bulls
games.story: Toronto scored the first basket, never trailed, and led 69-44 at halftime after a 43-point first quarter. The lead reached 48 with 3:24 left in the fourth quarter. Kawhi Leonard, Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley each scored 23 for the Raptors. Matas Buzelis led Chicago with 17 points.

games.headline: Pacers edge Pelicans 123-120 after a 67-point second half
games.story: New Orleans led 66-56 at halftime, and Indiana outscored the Pelicans 67-54 over the last two quarters. The game was tied for the last time at 1:40 of the fourth, and the Pacers went ahead for good at 120-118 with 1:23 to play. Pascal Siakam scored 30 with 8 rebounds, and Tyrese Haliburton had 23 points and 12 assists. Dejounte Murray scored 23 for New Orleans and Zion Williamson had 22.

games.headline: Ty Jerome scores 45 as Grizzlies beat Jazz 123-103
games.story: Memphis went ahead for good at 32-31 with 11:09 left in the second quarter and led 64-51 at halftime. The lead reached 27 with 6:14 left in the third. Ty Jerome scored 45 with 5 three-pointers, 7 rebounds and 6 assists. Keyonte George led Utah with 22 points, and Lauri Markkanen had 18 points and 9 rebounds.

games.headline: Rockets outscore Mavericks 38-12 in the second, win 128-110
games.story: Houston led 32-26 after the first quarter, then outscored Dallas 38-12 in the second for a 70-38 halftime margin. The lead peaked at 37 with 6:28 left in the third. Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. each scored 30, and Alperen Sengun had 23 points and 10 rebounds. Cooper Flagg led Dallas with 32 points.

games.headline: Lakers rout Warriors 127-105, led by Doncic's 28
games.story: Los Angeles went ahead for good at 34-33 with 30 seconds left in the first quarter and led 66-52 at halftime. Golden State scored 19 in the second quarter and 16 in the third. The Lakers' lead reached 35 with 11:23 left in the fourth. Luka Doncic scored 28 with 8 rebounds and 7 assists, Walker Kessler had 26 points and 9 rebounds, and Austin Reaves scored 23. Stephen Curry led the Warriors with 23 points.

games.headline: Trail Blazers beat Suns 124-83 after a 43-point first
games.story: Portland scored 43 in the first quarter to Phoenix's 12, led 72-39 at halftime, and never trailed. The lead reached 52 with 3:38 left in the game. Damian Lillard scored 25 with 6 three-pointers, and Deni Avdija had 18 points and 10 rebounds. Devin Booker led Phoenix with 23 points, and no other Sun scored more than 10.

games.headline: Clippers beat Kings 121-96 after a 41-point first quarter
games.story: Los Angeles scored 41 in the first quarter and went ahead for good at 6-3 with 11:00 left in the period. The Clippers led 61-54 at halftime, and the lead reached 28 with 6:47 left in the fourth. Darius Garland scored 30 and Brook Lopez had 17 points and 11 rebounds. Zach LaVine led Sacramento with 28 points, and Domantas Sabonis had 14 points and 18 rebounds.
